notes.title: UPDATE v1.03.16
notes.content:
v1.03.16
- Added an opportunity to close inventory by pressing ESC button.
- Added settings for sensitivity of car camera.
- Added window for confirm starting new game.
- Added automatic hiding of the notification window.
- FFreelancer: Added a visual information of your skill level.
- Reduced the fuel consumption.
- SkillUP: Reduced amount of days to end course.
- Increased the running speed.
- Improved car lights.
- Improved some translation bugs.
- Fixed the gates opening.
- Fixed the bug when bought house was flicking.
- Fixed the problem with registration on FFreelancer.
- Fixed some minor bugs.

Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1362340/Freelancer_Life_Simulator/]Freelancer Life Simulator[/url] and join to our [url=https://discord.gg/KBKpT3jW5x]Discord server[/url], there you can start discussing about the game or send us bug-report.

notes.title: DevLog #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is our [b]DevLog #1[/b].
Today we have liked to show you several features what completed at that moment.

[b]"OkkBank"[/b] site where you can check your payment history and get loans, if you will get problems with money.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38212007/5fd39abc3255352e8156048772690d011744ac8d.png[/img]
[b]Loans Page[/b]
There is you can get a loan, but be careful if you overdue loan payment, bank can ban your account for some days.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38212007/602f59e32472786ff44f6cd7f7b060be0edebaa3.png[/img]
[b]Bank history[/b]
There is you can check your last 10 payments.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38212007/7d62d37569c8b0ded9bc30c70926939d6cc9ac40.png[/img]

[b]SkillUP[/b] site where you can get new knowledge by learning courses. That will help you to get more interesting and highly paid tasks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38212007/5c0b43d807e4375e587f8a71e310551761ff388a.png[/img]
[b]Courses page[/b]
All courses divided by directions, so as you can se, in our game we have direcations like: [i]Programming, Design, Marketing, 3D Graphics, Speed and Management[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38212007/d3ba39534de839b2591949844965a9d2db577c10.gif[/img]
[b]Profile[/b]
When you choose courses what you like to learn, you can start learning in your profile.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38212007/eb102cf808dc299192a4b475a751a1a051340d9f.png[/img]

[b]Bitcoin[/b] site there you can sell your bitcoins or buy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38212007/c58d90f2ac5570bf4a34892af9ae59a1df029ca8.gif[/img]

[b]Bitcoin application[/b]
There is you can control of all mainers. Mainers can broken if is using all their power. So you need to be attentive, because mainer repairing is too expensive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38212007/8647e5dc3524419a69abba957071c6e7919ec975.png[/img]

[b]Thank you for reading.[/b]
You can suggest your own features, ideas via commenting announcements or sending email. 
Thanks to everyone who contributed to the development of the game.
Don't forget to add to your wish list.
